items.title: Mega Blast with the Secret band
items.description: A large open-air concert with the band Secret at Bolana Maha Vidyalaya grounds, Ambalantota, where Chathurya sang on a line-up of well-known Sri Lankan artists.

image_captions.images/03-06-secret-mega-blast-ambalanto: Secret Mega Blast concert poster, Bolana, Ambalantota

items.title: Ethera Nimnada Dubai
items.description: An international Sri Lankan music concert in Dubai, where Chathurya performed for the Sri Lankan community abroad alongside Shashika Nisansala, K Sujeewa, Dumal Warnakulasuriya and others, backed by Indika Kariyawasam with Signature.

items.description: Chathurya sang at the fifth edition of Sonduru Sihina Ra, an open-air theatre concert that was broadcast live.

items.title: Praana, Live in Concert
items.programme: Live concert with food festival and cultural show
items.description: Chathurya was one of the featured artists at Praana, a live concert presented by Show Bees at the NLDB farm premises by Weerawila Lake in Tissamaharama. She shared the stage with Umara Sinhawansa, her coach on The Voice Sri Lanka, along with Peshala Ridhma, Sanka, Piyath, Samanalee Fonseka and Indrachapa. The evening combined the concert with a food festival and cultural show, including a dance performance by Nirosha Thalagala.

items.title: Kandy Kisses
items.description: A Valentine's season concert at Gatambe Grounds, Kandy, organised by MindSpark with Shaa FM as media partner. Chathurya sang alongside Centigradz and Shashika Nisansala, with the band Arrow Star and a guest appearance by Podi Malli and Chooty Malli.

image_captions.images/02-18-kandy-kisses-gatambe-poster: Kandy Kisses concert poster, Gatambe Grounds, Kandy

items.title: Handawaka, Colombo
items.description: At Handawaka in Colombo, held at Arcade Independence Square, Chathurya joined Malith Perera on stage for a duet of Mathaka Mandira (Chanchala), sung to a packed open-air audience.
